title.narrative: “Ensuring early detection and timely response to acute health issues in border and high human mobility areas”

description.narrative: The main objective of this WHO project is to ensure the implementation of basic programs for health response, and to strengthen the response capacity of health personnel and the health services network. The project deploys health and medical personnel to provide essential health services, procures and distributes essential health supplies and equipment to laboratories and health centers. Moreover, the project assists in delivering rapid refresher training sessions for front-line health personnel and volunteers on timely outbreak detection, management and control provides early warning and epidemiological surveillance systems and essential health services for vulnerable communities in border area. The intervention provides humanitarian assistance to 66,000 people (21,474 men, 19,679 women and 23,847 children), including 1,291 persons with disabilities.
